evidence.text: Hey Maria! Good to see you. Just got back from a family road trip yesterday, it was fun! Anything exciting happening for you?

samples.findings: D1:2 explicitly says John returned from a family road trip yesterday; 2022-12-17 minus one day is 2022-12-16.

memory.value: join forces to create a safe and bustling environment

evidence.speaker: Maria
evidence.text: Yep, John! We should all join forces to create a safe and bustling environment for our community, and others too. Let's make some real change.

samples.findings: D14:22 supports the community-improvement goal, not a completed improvement. The date is correctly left unspecified.

memory.content: Maria volunteered at the shelter front desk last Friday.
memory.value: volunteered at the shelter front desk

evidence.speaker: Maria
evidence.text: Hey John, I'm here for you. Last Friday, I spent some time at the shelter volunteering at the front desk. Seeing the smiles on their faces when they got food or a bed really made me feel good. We have the power to make a difference in people's lives.

samples.findings: D32:14 says last Friday. Given Wednesday 2023-08-16, the ordinary most-recent-Friday interpretation is 2023-08-11; leaving event_time null loses a resolvable date.

memory.content: A car ran a red light and hit Maria and the kids, but everyone is okay.
memory.value: hit by a car that ran a red light; everyone okay

evidence.speaker: Maria
evidence.text: Hey John! They were great, their smiles warmed my heart. But something not so great happened yesterday...

evidence.speaker: Maria
evidence.text: A car ran a red light and hit us, but thankfully everyone is okay. Besides that, my cousin just had a tough time recently, so I'm lending a hand in helping her find a new place.

samples.findings: D21:3 and D21:5 support the accident on 2023-07-02 and everyone being okay. However D21:5 only says hit us. D21:1 mentions shelter children but never explicitly places them in the car. Adding and the kids is an unsupported pronoun resolution; use Maria and unspecified companions unless stronger evidence exists.

memory.content: Maria got a puppy named Coco two weeks ago.

evidence.speaker: Maria
evidence.text: Hey John! Long time no talk! Guess what - I got a puppy two weeks ago! Her name's Coco and she's adorable.

samples.findings: D30:1 supports Maria getting Coco two weeks earlier. Exact two-week subtraction from 2023-08-11 gives 2023-07-28 under the literal date interpretation.

memory.content: Last week, John realized how much veterans have done and wanted to show appreciation.
memory.value: wanted to show appreciation to veterans

evidence.speaker: John
evidence.text: Hi Maria, thanks for asking. I've always been passionate about veterans and their rights. Last week, I realized again how much they've done for us and wanted to show my appreciation in some way. So, I worked on a project to support them. It's my way of giving back.

samples.findings: D15:3 supports John reflecting on veterans last week. A week interval cannot be represented as an exact day; null is appropriate.

memory.content: Maria adopted a puppy from a shelter last week.

evidence.text: Wow, John! You're doing great things. Kudos for helping kids learn. On another note, I just adopted this cute pup from a shelter last week. She brings so much joy! I feel blessed to be able to give her a home.

samples.findings: D31:2 says Maria adopted a puppy from a shelter last week. Kept as an additional event alongside Coco acquisition; last week is not resolved to a fabricated day.

evidence.text: Her name is Shadow! She's full of energy and always puts a smile on my face. She's been a great addition to my life. They get along great.

samples.findings: D31:4 explicitly names the new puppy Shadow. D31:3 asks about her other dog, so preserving Coco and Shadow separately is supported; do not overwrite Coco as a renamed pet.
